integration.content_dependency: Each runtime episode should have a matching visit-experience episode entry; look_first is preferred for the single field cue.

invariants: shared app.js player/resume/media-session semantics remain authoritative

deep prose and source material remain secondary
classic V1 remains reachable from the V2 overflow
